profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX and files with the SEC under CIK 0001576789. Its website presents it as a free website builder that lets users create a site in minutes, offering 2,000+ templates, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools. The company says templates can be customized manually or with AI, and that users can sell products, services, and memberships from one dashboard with zero plugins.

On the AI side, the site describes specialized AI agents that it says help keep a business growing, alongside the built-in AI tools in the builder. The company's own framing is that these features are part of a free, easy-to-use product aimed at getting a website online quickly.

The record lists no lawsuits involving the company and no AI products tracked separately from the website builder itself.
